item.title: Thalia Accepts the Icon Award | Billboard Women In Music 2026
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates from the world of music. Tonight, we're coming to you live from the Hollywood Palladium, where the Billboard Women in Music 2026 awards are taking place.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: "The event is honoring some of the most talented women in the music industry, including EJAE, REI AMI, AUDREY NUNA, Kehlani, Teyana Taylor, Ella Langley, Thalia, Zara Larsson, Laufey, and Tate McRae.
[Music transitions to a slight highlight]
Host: "And one of the highlights of the evening is Thalia, who is being honored with the prestigious Icon award. We're excited to see her accept this well-deserved recognition.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for now from the Billboard Women in Music 2026 awards. Congratulations to all the honorees, and especially to Thalia on her Icon award. We'll be back with more updates soon."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
